name: Life Admin
tagline: Watches your email and calendar for the adult deadlines everyone lets slip
description: It reads your mail and calendar hunting the commitments that quietly expire, renewals, tickets, forms, appointments, and drafts whatever paperwork each needs. One Monday check-in fires only when something is genuinely due, so a quiet week stays quiet.
